name: hud_sensor_map_overlay_ref_toggle
description: HudSensorTracker::MapOverlayRefToggle reference-counts mission-map overlay display requests, begins showing when the count becomes positive, ends showing when the count drops to zero or below, clamps the count at zero, and returns success.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the HUD sensor map source-cluster pass so the member-call shape for begin/end helper calls can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x416b30 validates the enable increment path, disable decrement path, clamp-to-zero behavior, MapOverlayBeginShow call when the reference count is positive, MapOverlayEndShow call when the count reaches zero, and success return.
The native HUD sensor map smoke verifies two enables, a non-closing disable while the count remains positive, final disable/clamp to zero, and the begin/end scale-state side effects.
